name: Calendar, Contacts and Mail
author: Wasi Master
description: Shows calendar, contact and email files in the keyboard's file manager: the events in an .ics file with their times, places and repeats; every contact in a .vcf file with phone numbers, emails and addresses; and an .eml message with its sender, recipients, text and attachments, or a whole .mbox mailbox. The grid shows a contact's photo.
